text:
Priya Nair: Opening a focused docs PR to unify quota tier examples + dashboard rename notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478
Tom Reynolds: Nice. Can we show a minimal tier mapping table in prose (Free, Starter, Scale) and a small cost calc for each? PMs want quick copy for the pricing page.
Priya Nair: Will add inline examples. Plan: one paragraph describing tiered metering behavior, then three short code snippets (curl, ts-sdk, java) showing how to read headers and compute spend.
Ivy Zhang: Heads up — backend now sends `X-Quota-Tier` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` in addition to `X-RateLimit-Remaining`. Docs should explain how to use `X-Quota-Tier` for client-side routing to cheaper models.
Omar Reyes: For the dashboard rename, Console panel is now "Token consumption (Tokens/day)". We need to update image filenames and the grafana link id. I'll attach new PNGs.
Priya Nair: Draft curl snippet for consumers who want to surface burst credits and tier in monitoring:
```bash
curl -sI \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate | \
  jq -r '.headers["X-Burst-Credits"], .headers["X-Quota-Tier"]'
```
Tom Reynolds: Small nit: `jq -r` on response headers only works with our proxy test harness. For real responses we should show parsing from raw headers, or a note that some HTTP clients expose headers differently.
Priya Nair: Good point. I'll add a two-line note and an example using curl + grep for plain text parsing.
Ivy Zhang: SDK snippets: include TypeScript async + Java blocking. Keep math example: compute USD per 1k tokens and show rounding to cents. Also mention rounding edge cases for microbilled requests.
Priya Nair: TS snippet:
```ts
// TypeScript example: estimate cost
const tokens = 1530;
const costPer1k = 0.0025; // USD per 1k tokens
const est = (tokens / 1000) * costPer1k;
console.log(`Estimated cost: $${est.toFixed(4)}`);
```
Omar Reyes: For screenshots, I uploaded updated panels to the PR branch: `assets/console/token_consumption_v2.png`. Update alt-text too.
Priya Nair: Migration note draft: "If your Dedicated telemetry proxy is older than v2.1.3, you will see `x-old-quota-tier` and may need to map it to new tier names. See mapping table."
Tom Reynolds: Add a short troubleshooting subsection: wrong tier showing = stale config in proxy, run `telemetry-proxy migrate-config` as a fix.
Ivy Zhang: L10n: keep original console label in parentheses for 14 days to avoid translator churn. Add a TODO comment in the markdown with date.
DocsBot: PR 478 created by Priya Nair  CI: docs-build (staging) passed 063; Preview: https://deploy-preview-478--docs.redwood.ai
Priya Nair: QA checklist I'm leaving on the PR: update snippet outputs, verify curl parsing on mac/linux, replace screenshots, add changelog entry under "docs: metering & quotas (console rename)", and confirm i18n keys.
Tom Reynolds: I'll review the cost math and the Java snippet tomorrow.
Omar Reyes: I'll follow up with a small screenshot PR if reviewers want higher-res images.
Ivy Zhang: I'll prepare the l10n ticket after merge.
Priya Nair: Aiming to merge Wed EOD, will ping #announcements after release. :sparkles:
